import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Example 1
try:
    X = np.array([[1, 1], [1, -1]], dtype=float)
    beta = np.array([1, -1e3], dtype=float)
    y = X @ beta
    
    model = ElasticNetCV(cv=2, fit_intercept=False, positive=True, max_iter=5000)
    model.fit(X, y)
    
    # Record the alpha_max value from the model
    probe("ElasticNetCV(cv=2, fit_intercept=False, positive=True) on X=[[1, 1], [1, -1]], beta=[1, -1e3], y=X@beta", 
          {"alpha_max": model.alpha_, "n_alphas": len(model.alphas_) if hasattr(model, 'alphas_') else None})
    
    # Also check what happens at 0.99 * alpha_max
    alpha_test = 0.99 * model.alpha_
    model_test = ElasticNetCV(cv=2, fit_intercept=False, positive=True, alphas=[alpha_test], max_iter=5000)
    model_test.fit(X, y)
    max_coef = np.max(np.abs(model_test.coef_))
    probe("ElasticNetCV(cv=2, fit_intercept=False, positive=True) on X=[[1, 1], [1, -1]], beta=[1, -1e3], y=X@beta - coef at 0.99*alpha_max", 
          {"max_abs_coef": max_coef, "coef": model_test.coef_.tolist()})

    probe("ElasticNetCV(cv=2, fit_intercept=False, positive=True) on X=[[1, 1], [1, -1]], beta=[1, -1e3], y=X@beta",
